tasks.instruction: Restore the full bounded native OpenRouter music response contract: validate and replay original MP3/WAV SSE bytes up to the existing 16 MiB decoded-audio boundary and exactly 32 MiB wire ceiling, rather than imposing the smaller partial-response limit or decoding an aggregate audio copy. Use the existing scalar music inspector to validate model identity, request audio format, base64, usage, transcript and terminal semantics. Quarantine until a valid DONE; preserve original SSE bytes and diagnostic usage without inventing prices. Read only byte streams with separate returned BYOB windows bounded to 64 KiB; DONE must not wait for EOF or buffer fill. Bound reads, events, frame bytes, line count, wire bytes and inspector limits; reject malformed UTF-8, unsupported/multiline framing, error keys/events, filtered output, post-terminal content, wrong MIME/status/range/encoding/redirect, non-byte streams and truncated completion. Respect caller cancellation and memory lease ownership. Preserve exact destination, request validation and output headers. Never reconnect, generate a second response, decode a payload-sized audio copy, or expose partial SSE before validation.
